name: Virtual Global Education Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Virtual Global Education Limited is in the business of skill development, training and providing placement to unemployed youth
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company provides skill development and employability training and is partnering with various government bodies in fulfilling Skill India Initiative of Government of India by providing Skill training for more than 1 Million youth in India by 2023. Company derives its revenues primarily from skilling and training and project comprised under Common Norms of National Skill Development Corporation

pros: Stock is trading at 0.33 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
